notes.title: Major update! Twenty new item and features!
notes.content:
Major update! Twenty new item and features! We took your feedbacks into consideration and added them to the game.

We added twenty new improvable items. New atmosphere, AI updates, technical updates,menu updates, new tools and details that are going to improve the gameplay. Your opinions mean us a lot, so please, if you have ideas, just fire away. Have fun!

notes.title: New Update!
notes.content:
We will fix the errors that affect the gameplay in the update that comes within 1-2 days. There will be maps added, to guide you through the game. We will widen the crafting range in order to present an even better experience. 

Your opinions mean us a lot, so if you guys have ideas, just fire away. Thank you!
